title: Calendula officinalis cream for medicinal use
intro: Calendula officinalis cream is a topical preparation made from the dried flowers of the Calendula plant, commonly used in herbalism for its soothing and healing properties. It is often applied to the skin to treat minor burns, cuts, and skin irritations due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The cream helps to reduce redness, promote wound healing, and alleviate itching. In herbal practice, it is also used to address eczema, psoriasis, and other inflammatory skin conditions. Its gentle nature makes it suitable for use on sensitive skin and in natural skincare routines.
